_comment: AP Networking 4.3: navigate and transfer files from a CLI.
The authored source for this lab is config/networking-hands-on.json, entry
item_id 4.3-lab. Everything here implements that entry: eight checks, one
point each, anchored to the EK statements it names, with check 8 as the
VERIFY step that exists because 'no error appeared' is the false proof
ZERO PII, AND THE ONE PLACE IT IS EASY TO BREAK
A terminal collects typed strings and a typed string is free text. The
player evaluates every check in the browser and posts the check index and
its boolean, never the command line. See docs/lab-contract.md.
title: Move a site survey to the file server
page_title: AP Networking Lab: Move a File With SFTP | Topic 4.3 Terminal Practice
seo_description: Work a real terminal in your browser: navigate a filesystem, open an SFTP session, transfer a site survey and prove it landed. Free AP Networking Topic 4.3 lab.
brief: You finished a wireless site survey for the school library and saved it on your own machine. The network team keeps every survey on the file server at files.school.net so the next person can find it. Yours is still sitting in your home folder.
Get it onto the server, in the right year folder, and then prove it actually landed.
1. Use `pwd` to confirm where you are.
2. `cd reports` and `ls` to find the survey.
3. Answer the question about command parts below.
4. You will need `put`. Read what it does with `help put` before you use it.
8. Prove it arrived. `ls` the folder you sent it to. An upload that printed no error is not evidence.
Type `help` at any time for the command list.

questions.prompt: In the command `cp -r reports backup`, which part is the option?
questions.explain: The command is `cp`. An option starts with a dash and changes how the command behaves; `-r` tells cp to copy a whole directory. `reports` and `backup` are the arguments it acts on.

_solution_comment: The reference run. smoke/labs.js plays exactly these steps against the real player and fails if all eight checks do not tick, so a spec can never ship as an unfinishable lab.

checks.label: Report which directory you are working in
Move into reports/ and list it
Break a command into command, option and argument
Find out what a command does without leaving the terminal
Open an SFTP session to files.school.net
Navigate the server side, not your own machine
Transfer the survey in the right direction (put, not get)
VERIFY: list the destination and see the file there
